[Legit at this mode's default]

Enemies sometimes get a turn of frequent critical hits, always announced one turn ahead. It replaces flat crit-chance bonuses for enemies: the fight escalates and keeps you tense without forcing you into anti-crit builds.

[Legit at this mode's default]

At a quarter health a marked boss turns vulnerable to one random damage type, while all other damage is reflected back at the attacker. The boss enters a desperate state, gaining extra resources. A demanding mechanic for the well-prepared.

[Legit at this mode's default]

Below half health, divine grace descends on the boss, stripping all harmful effects and restoring its resources, while the party must pass saving throws to keep control. During Eclipse the boss grows notably stronger and takes a full turn.

[Legit at this mode's default]

The first time a tough enemy drops to a third of its health it gains a little temporary health.

[Legit at this mode's default]

A powerful boss struck down rises once per fight with half its health and an Action Surge.

[Legit at this mode's default]

Interplanar caches that appear at random across the world; how many appear, and whether they open on their own, follows your mode.

[Legit at this mode's default]

A powerful enemy above half its hit points that takes no damage on its own turn gains an Action Surge the next turn.
